description: This file defines the interface GLAccountReadPlatformService in Java, which declares methods for retrieving GL account data, including account retrieval, filtering, and lookup functionalities within the Fineract accounting module.

methods.name: retrieveAllGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all GL accounts filtered by classification, search parameters, usage, transaction permissions, disabled status, and optional association parameters.

methods.name: retrieveGLAccountById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific GL account identified by its ID, with optional association parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledDetailGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all enabled detail GL accounts.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledDetailGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all enabled detail GL accounts filtered by a specific account type.

methods.name: retrieveAllEnabledHeaderGLAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all enabled header GL accounts filtered by account type.

methods.name: retrieveNewGLAccountDetails
methods.description: Provides details necessary to create a new GL account of a specified type.

methods.name: retrieveAccountsByTagId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GL account data for tags identified by a rule ID and transaction type.
